release_observation.semantics: backend_release_done_ready is constant one; slot is the lowest asserted lane and mask preserves simultaneous lanes

clock_reset_cancel_semantics.clock_domain: all B state is sampled on the rising edge of clk
clock_reset_cancel_semantics.reset: rst_n assertion is asynchronous across the B composition; deassertion must be synchronized by the caller
clock_reset_cancel_semantics.reset_outputs: reset clears result_valid, clipped, slot state, snapshot valid, release state, and both FSMs to IDLE; aborted is zero while rst_n is zero
clock_reset_cancel_semantics.cancel_combinational_fence: while cancel is high, event_ready, sample_ready, read_ready, publish, and new backend launch are suppressed
clock_reset_cancel_semantics.cancel_edge: on the next rising edge with cancel high, audio_state becomes DRAIN and result_valid is cleared; scheduler/backend owned work is drained or fenced
clock_reset_cancel_semantics.cancel_hold: audio_state remains DRAIN while cancel stays high
clock_reset_cancel_semantics.cancel_release: after cancel is low, DRAIN returns to IDLE only when scheduler is not busy, backend is empty, and the control snapshot channel is empty/ready
clock_reset_cancel_semantics.abort_reason: 1 for cancel; 2 for slot-identity drift while audio_state is LOAD_CTL through HOLD; aborted is qualified by rst_n and is low in IDLE/DRAIN

public_read_timing.acceptance: read_valid && read_ready on a rising edge
public_read_timing.ready: read_ready is high only when rst_n, public idle, scheduler read readiness, !sample_valid, and !cancel are all true
public_read_timing.priority: sample and read are mutually excluded at the public boundary; event ownership is also blocked during either request
public_read_timing.response_latency: read_out_valid asserts for the cycle immediately following an accepted read (one rising-edge latency)
public_read_timing.payload: read_context is valid exactly when read_out_valid is high; invalid/unconfigured slots return zero
public_read_timing.streaming: back-to-back reads are permitted when read_valid remains asserted and each cycle has read_ready high

control_snapshot_timing.request: audio_state CONTROL accepts an internal request when the snapshot block request_ready is high
control_snapshot_timing.scan_latency: for N=32, one lane is read per rising edge and control_snapshot_valid asserts 32 cycles after the request handshake
control_snapshot_timing.ready: control_snapshot_ready is high in audio_state WAIT_CONTROL or DRAIN
control_snapshot_timing.handshake: control_snapshot_valid && control_snapshot_ready transfers the full id/value/identity payload on a rising edge
control_snapshot_timing.hold: valid and the full payload remain stable until the handshake
control_snapshot_timing.drain: DRAIN keeps ready high to consume any stale snapshot before returning to IDLE

control_release_timing.meaning: CC64/note-off/panic release batch emitted by the sustain controller
control_release_timing.valid: control_release_valid is the OR of the immutable pending mask
control_release_timing.hold: mask and per-lane generations remain stable while valid is high and ready is low
control_release_timing.ready: the router asserts control_release_ready only in RELEASE_ACK after scanning and applying every matching lane
control_release_timing.handshake: valid && ready clears the batch on the rising edge; that same edge cannot accept a new sustain command

backend_release_done_timing.meaning: observation of backend envelope completion presented to the router retirement fence
backend_release_done_timing.ready: constant one observation flag; it is not a backpressure input
backend_release_done_timing.simultaneous_lanes: backend_release_done_mask is authoritative when more than one lane is asserted
backend_release_done_timing.repeat: a lane may remain asserted across cycles until router retirement; scoreboards must deduplicate by slot and generation

compile_contract.fixed_instance: b_n32_r1_wrapper #(.N(32), .RESPONSE(1)); other values terminate with N32_B_FIXED_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED
compile_contract.vendor_GSR: C testbench must instantiate GSR GSR(.GSRI(1'b1)); prim_sim.v is listed before the testbench
compile_contract.order_rule: compile_sources is an ordered array; use it exactly and append no active-worktree substitute

forbidden_access: C must not use hierarchical reads of B internal registers
